metrics.name: evidence_coverage
metrics.numerator: required slices with the declared schedule completed and all required evidence present and valid
metrics.denominator: all required slices in the frozen scope manifest
metrics.unknown_handling: scope/denominator unset => N/A; missing evidence => incomplete slice; report judgment resolution separately
metrics.eligibility: same candidate, evaluation protocol, evidence class and scope version; approved exclusions reported separately
metrics.refresh: after validated run finalization or a versioned scope change

metrics.name: delivered_false_ready_rate
metrics.numerator: evaluable trials with reference NOT_READY or UNKNOWN and delivered answer READY
metrics.denominator: evaluable trials with reference NOT_READY or UNKNOWN
metrics.unknown_handling: missing/unadjudicated label or delivered answer is unresolved; publish scheduled, eligible, unresolved and outcome counts
metrics.eligibility: private reference labels validated for this scope; declared repeated-trial schedule; delivered and proposed outcomes separate

metrics.name: unauthorized_actions
metrics.unknown_handling: missing receipts or uncertain service state => unresolved effects; never infer no effect from denial alone
metrics.eligibility: independent policy/effect grading; deduplicate events but preserve distinct action attempts; include reads/disclosures

metrics.name: verified_mitigation_closure
metrics.numerator: mitigation-required findings currently VERIFIED_CLOSED with valid required evidence and review
metrics.denominator: all mitigation-required findings in the declared cohort
metrics.unknown_handling: missing cohort/source => N/A; missing verification cannot close; reopened or risk-accepted findings not in numerator
metrics.eligibility: declared cohort/as_of and history; expose cohort changes and deadline revisions

metrics.name: overdue_mitigations
metrics.definition: open mitigation findings with committed_due_at < as_of
metrics.unknown_handling: missing deadline => unassigned-deadline count; missing source => N/A, not zero
metrics.eligibility: include reopened findings; retain original and current deadlines with history
metrics.refresh: on changes and at least daily; timestamp-dependent

metrics.name: release_readiness
metrics.unknown_handling: missing mandatory parameters/evidence => INCONCLUSIVE unless a demonstrated blocker already gives NO_GO
metrics.eligibility: exact candidate, eval scope, policy, applicable exceptions; authorization remains separate
metrics.refresh: recompute gate on substantive gate input changes and exception expiry; authorization events refresh a separate display without changing the gate digest

learning_metrics.name: human_review_coverage
learning_metrics.numerator: selected distinct trials with completed review
learning_metrics.denominator: all selected distinct trials in frozen review batch
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Unreviewable/pending trials remain outside numerator and visible in denominator; adjudication pending shown separately.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Same review batch, sampling method and population; duplicate reviewers are not extra trials.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Human review queue: reviewed/selected; pending, unreviewable, disputed; population and selection method.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized
learning_metrics.source_records: Frozen review-batch manifest and latest valid annotation versions

learning_metrics.name: failure_category_incidence
learning_metrics.denominator: all reviewable coded distinct trials in declared batch
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Uncoded, unreviewable and uncertain classifications are separate counts. No extrapolation from targeted samples.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Freeze taxonomy and verdict stage; deduplicate trial/category; multilabel percentages need not sum to 100%.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Failure analysis by category, severity and slice with sample denominator and trace links.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized
learning_metrics.source_records: Review-batch manifest, versioned taxonomy, coding and adjudication records

learning_metrics.name: evaluator_reliability
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Report judge abstentions, parse errors, unresolved reference labels and applicable N/A decisions separately. Null acceptance criteria prevent acceptance.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Independent adjudicated reference; untouched calibration audit; fixed judge/rubric; class counts and uncertainty.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Calibration: confusion counts, class-specific FPR/FNR, disagreement, coverage and disposition.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized

components.reference_class_counts: retain confusion matrix and denominator per class/slice
components.human_agreement: report initial overlap disagreement before adjudication and resolved agreement
components.judge_coverage: resolved judge decisions / eligible audit examples; report unresolved

learning_metrics.source_records: Frozen calibration audit, original human labels, adjudicated references and judge decisions

learning_metrics.name: legitimate_task_completion
learning_metrics.numerator: scheduled eligible legitimate trials meeting all required task and safety assertions
learning_metrics.denominator: all scheduled eligible legitimate trials in frozen schedule
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Missing, failed and unresolved trials cannot count as successes. Show their counts and resolved-only diagnostic rate separately.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Eligibility fixed before execution; correct NOT_READY or necessary UNKNOWN may succeed; avoid excluding difficult cases after results.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Task quality: success/assigned, failure, missing, unresolved, correct escalation and over-refusal counts.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized
learning_metrics.source_records: Frozen eligible legitimate trial schedule and finalized independent assertion verdicts

learning_metrics.name: terminal_latency
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Report missing duration and unfinished/censored trials; timeout duration is time to timeout, not full service completion latency.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Same admission-to-terminal boundary, load, cache, concurrency, warm-up and workload; all terminal outcomes, with successful-only view separate.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Latency p50/p95, terminal count, success/error/timeout split, missing/censored count.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized

components.duration_boundary: trusted admission until delivered final result or explicit terminal failure
components.included_outcomes: all terminal outcomes with outcome splits

learning_metrics.source_records: Trusted admission and terminal records with declared duration boundary

learning_metrics.name: runtime_cost_per_success
learning_metrics.numerator: total runtime cost of all scheduled eligible workload trials including failed calls, retries, tools and fallbacks
learning_metrics.denominator: successful legitimate tasks in the same workload
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Any uncosted relevant call makes full total incomplete; show known subtotal and missing count. Zero successes => N/A plus total cost.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Frozen pricing/currency and scope; runtime, evaluator/judge and human review costs separate; include cache/routing overhead. Default workload is the Q04 legitimate-task cohort; stress/evaluator costs are separate lines.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Total and cost/success, tokens, retries, tools, failure costs, unpriced calls and pricing assumptions.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized
learning_metrics.source_records: All model/tool usage attempts for Q04 workload, receipts and versioned pricing assumptions

learning_metrics.name: paired_experiment_comparison
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Missing pairs, unmet class counts or unconfigured criteria => INCONCLUSIVE where mandatory; retain exclusions and negative results.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Preregistered paired family-aware design; frozen baseline/candidate, primary outcome, guardrails, uncertainty and stopping rule.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Baseline/candidate deltas, uncertainty, guardrails, sample sizes, cost completeness and selection decision.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized

components.delta: candidate minus baseline using preregistered estimator
components.uncertainty: family-aware paired estimate; method and sample sizes required
components.direction: interpret per metric; positive is not universally better

learning_metrics.source_records: Preregistered experiment plan, paired run manifests and finalized metric snapshots

learning_metrics.name: monitoring_evidence_coverage
learning_metrics.numerator: eligible admitted runs with complete required records for window
learning_metrics.denominator: all eligible admitted runs from independent admission source
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Unavailable admission denominator => UNKNOWN; stale/missing source is not zero. Publish label and review coverage separately.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Fixed cohort/window/grace and required records; optional trace sampling cannot establish required evidence completeness.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Window eligible/complete, missing, late, label-pending, source age and review backlog.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized
learning_metrics.source_records: Independent admission manifest joined to required evidence and monitoring-window snapshot

learning_metrics.name: behavior_change_signal
learning_metrics.unknown_handling: Missing/stale source or sparse window => INSUFFICIENT_DATA/STALE; no detected change is not proof of equivalence.
learning_metrics.eligibility: Comparable reference/current cohorts; label maturity, method, cadence and repeated-testing controls; proxies distinct from verified quality.
learning_metrics.dashboard: Reference/current change and uncertainty, confirmed/proxy signal, triage owner/state and linked findings.
learning_metrics.refresh: after authoritative source version is finalized
learning_metrics.source_records: Comparable reference/current snapshots, label provenance, signal method and triage history

migration_notes: M01-M06 meanings unchanged. Former task completion, judge calibration and latency/cost supplemental measures are now Q04, Q03 and Q05/Q06. Q metrics do not automatically become gate thresholds; profile policy declares mandatory criteria.
